youtube_description:
On October 11th, TEDxAmericasFinestCity speaker Marian Bartlett will discuss transforming technology through demonstrating novel technology that recognizes facial expressions in real-time that can detect our internal states and predict our intentions. 

Tickets are available here to our upcoming event #TransformationThrough US: http://www.eventbrite.com/e/tedxamericasfinestcity-tickets-12678173759?aff=youtube

Learn more at http://www.tedxamericasfinestcity.com
